home.h1: Free and Easy PDF Tools Online
home.intro: Convert, merge, split, compress and edit PDF files online. No installation needed, no sign-up required. Fast, secure, and free.

howItWorksSteps.title: Upload your file
howItWorksSteps.desc: Select or drag & drop your file. We support PDF, Word, Excel, images, and more.

howItWorksSteps.title: Convert instantly
howItWorksSteps.desc: Our server processes your file in seconds using trusted open-source libraries.

howItWorksSteps.title: Download the result
howItWorksSteps.desc: Your converted file is ready to download. Files are deleted after 30 minutes.

whyUsPoints.title: 100% Free
whyUsPoints.desc: All core tools are free, with no hidden fees or watermarks.

whyUsPoints.title: Privacy First
whyUsPoints.desc: Files are deleted automatically. We never read or share your documents.

whyUsPoints.title: No Account Needed
whyUsPoints.desc: Just upload, convert, and download. No sign-up, ever.

whyUsPoints.title: Works Everywhere
whyUsPoints.desc: Use FlowToPDF on any device — desktop, tablet, or mobile.

faqItems.a: Yes. All tools are free to use. We may show ads to support server costs, but conversions are always free.
Absolutely. Files are processed on our secure servers and deleted automatically after conversion or within 30 minutes.
You can upload files up to 50 MB. For larger files, please split them first.

faqItems.q: Do I need to install anything?
faqItems.a: No. FlowToPDF runs entirely in your browser. No software installation required.
We support PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG), text, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and more.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF to Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Convert PDF files to editable Word documents (DOCX) while preserving formatting.

word-to-pdf.name: Word to PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Turn Word documents (DOCX, DOC) into PDF files instantly.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.desc: Convert JPG images to PDF with customizable page size and margins.

png-to-pdf.name: PNG to PDF
png-to-pdf.desc: Convert PNG images to PDF, preserving transparency as white background.

webp-to-pdf.name: WebP to PDF
webp-to-pdf.desc: Convert modern WebP images to a high-quality PDF document.

gif-to-pdf.name: GIF to PDF
gif-to-pdf.desc: Convert GIF images (first frame) to a PDF file.

pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF to JPG
pdf-to-jpg.desc: Extract pages from a PDF and save each as a JPG image.

pdf-to-png.name: PDF to PNG
pdf-to-png.desc: Convert PDF pages to high-quality PNG images.

pdf-to-text.name: PDF to Text
pdf-to-text.desc: Extract all text content from a PDF as a plain text file.

text-to-pdf.name: Text to PDF
text-to-pdf.desc: Convert plain text files (.txt) to a neatly formatted PDF.

html-to-pdf.name: HTML to PDF
html-to-pdf.desc: Convert HTML code or web content to a PDF document.

markdown-to-pdf.name: Markdown to PDF
markdown-to-pdf.desc: Convert Markdown files to a formatted PDF document.

excel-to-pdf.name: Excel to PDF
excel-to-pdf.desc: Convert Excel spreadsheets (XLSX, XLS) to PDF format.

powerpoint-to-pdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
powerpoint-to-pdf.desc: Convert PowerPoint presentations (PPTX, PPT) to PDF.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.desc: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.desc: Split a PDF into individual pages or custom page ranges.

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.desc: Reduce the file size of your PDF while maintaining quality.

rotate-pdf.name: Rotate PDF
rotate-pdf.desc: Rotate all or selected pages in a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

protect-pdf.name: Protect PDF
protect-pdf.desc: Add a password to your PDF to prevent unauthorized access.

unlock-pdf.name: Unlock PDF
unlock-pdf.desc: Remove password protection from a PDF (requires knowing the password).

reorder-pdf.name: Reorder PDF Pages
reorder-pdf.desc: Drag and drop to rearrange pages in your PDF document.

extract-pages.name: Extract Pages
extract-pages.desc: Extract specific pages from a PDF into a new document.

image-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Combine multiple images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into one PDF file.

svg-to-pdf.name: SVG to PDF
svg-to-pdf.desc: Convert SVG vector graphics to a PDF document.

ocr-pdf.name: OCR PDF
ocr-pdf.desc: Make scanned PDFs searchable using optical character recognition.

docx-to-pdf.name: DOCX to PDF
docx-to-pdf.desc: Convert DOCX files to PDF format.

odt-to-pdf.name: ODT to PDF
odt-to-pdf.desc: Convert OpenDocument Text files to PDF.

rtf-to-pdf.name: RTF to PDF
rtf-to-pdf.desc: Convert Rich Text Format files to PDF.

csv-to-pdf.name: CSV to PDF
csv-to-pdf.desc: Convert CSV data files to a PDF table.
